lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li12Fe4Te4 (reduced formula Li3FeTe) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Te centers each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Li neighbors, while Li centers have one Fe and three Te neighbors, all at 2.5726 Å. The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Fe and Te tetrahedra, corner-sharing between Li and Te tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Li-centered 4-vertex polyhedra.
